purpose: Public-safe roadmap for turning AI, finance risk, compliance, and country case studies into reader-first pages, reports, and infographics.
reader_rule: Start from a real-world question, show the source trail, explain the system record, name the missing context, then state the clear limit.
visual_principles: Use diagrams to explain systems, not to decorate pages.
Prefer source trail, system record, missing context, and clear limit over raw code or raw logs.
Keep country and institution examples educational unless a source record has been checked.
No trading signal, KYC approval, filing, legal advice, or autonomous action claim.

learning_lanes.label: Wallet watching
learning_lanes.title: Public wallet source trail
learning_lanes.reader_question: How does a public wallet label become a cautious review question instead of a market signal?
learning_lanes.clear_limit: No copy trading, no wallet control, and no claim that a public label proves wrongdoing.

learning_lanes.label: KYC and records
learning_lanes.title: KYC record path
learning_lanes.reader_question: What can AI summarize in a KYC file, and what still needs a person or regulated workflow?
learning_lanes.clear_limit: Not a KYC approval and not a licensed compliance product.

learning_lanes.label: Settlement
learning_lanes.title: Stablecoin settlement record
learning_lanes.reader_question: Where do stablecoins change payment speed, reconciliation, and audit trails without removing counterparty risk?
learning_lanes.clear_limit: Educational settlement map only, not financial advice or payment-system certification.

learning_lanes.label: Agent controls
learning_lanes.title: Agent decision and stop map
learning_lanes.reader_question: When an AI agent can use tools, where are the access checks, records, and human stops?
learning_lanes.clear_limit: No hidden prompt plumbing or raw private adapter code is published.

learning_lanes.label: Country practices
learning_lanes.title: Country-by-country risk practice notes
learning_lanes.reader_question: How do different countries frame AI, payments, wallet monitoring, and compliance controls?
learning_lanes.clear_limit: No legal advice and no claim that one country model can be copied without local review.

learning_lanes.label: Failure library
learning_lanes.title: Learn from other people’s mistakes
learning_lanes.reader_question: What broke, what record was missing, and what guard would have caught it earlier?
learning_lanes.clear_limit: No blame framing, no bank-negative claims, and no unsupported allegation.
